reported_failed_attempts.attempt: Match covariance instead of the full queried joint law
reported_failed_attempts.failure_scope: Independent signs and (a,b,ab) agree pairwise but three commuting pi/4 sign pulses give coherence factors 0 and i. Exact finite-query independence is stronger than covariance agreement.

reported_failed_attempts.attempt: Redraw a private seed after each control or time cell
reported_failed_attempts.failure_scope: For static Gaussian dephasing the coherence changes from exp(-2 sigma^2 T^2) to exp(-2 sigma^2 T^2/M), tending to one. Persistent environmental memory is essential.

reported_failed_attempts.attempt: Use the seed as a full path sampler or unlimited oracle
reported_failed_attempts.failure_scope: A 2Q-wise polynomial table need only match the fixed Q-query circuit; full table distributions may have nearly maximal total-variation discrepancy. All scratch/seed information must stay private and query costs must be fixed before seed selection.

reported_failed_attempts.attempt: Remove switching-rate cost while holding white-noise intensity fixed for free
reported_failed_attempts.failure_scope: At fixed integrated OU strength, amplitude grows as sqrt(lambda); the Hamiltonian-action resource S grows. Logarithmic rate dependence at fixed amplitude is not a free white-noise limit.
